channel.title: HK IPO HOT
channel.description: Hong Kong IPO subscription calendar: now subscribing, listing soon, listing today, grey market and debut — titles, one-line summaries and links only.

item.title: Changzhou Microintelligence Co., Ltd. (03275)
item.description: Robotics firm Microintelligence relaunched its offering on 23 November at HK$12.07-15.69, with subscriptions open 23 November to 1 December and listing on 4 December; it withdrew its October attempt and now seeks up to about HK$585 million. Oversubscribed about 75.9 times.

item.title: SSI New Material (Zhenjiang) Co., Ltd. (03707)
item.description: New materials company SSI New Material is set to list on 7 December, with an offer price of HK$6.00 to HK$7.00.

item.title: Yuen Kee Food Group Co., Ltd. (03364)
item.description: Food company Yuen Kee Food Group is set to list on 7 December, with an offer price of HK$23.00 to HK$28.00.
